articles.summaryOriginal: Winning two gold medals at the 2026 Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games, Chinese diving star Chen Yuxi continues to look beyond the podium. In an exclusive conversation with China Daily's online show Spotlight , Chen reflects on her Asian Games journey, the mindset behind each dive, and her constant pursuit of improvement. For Chen, diving is like polishing a piece of artwork — there is always something to refine, and every competition brings new experiences and challenges. More than a sport, diving has also become an inseparable part of her life. To find out more, click the video.

articles.titleOriginal: Seoul says written proof of POW secrecy deal exists as Lee urges Ukraine to apologize
articles.titleJa: ソウルは、リーがウクライナに謝罪するよう促しているため、捕虜の秘密取引の書面による証拠が存在すると述べている
articles.summaryJa: 韓国は金曜日、イ・ジェミョン大統領がウクライナに謝罪するか追加措置を講じるよう警告したため、韓国とキエフが2人の北朝鮮捕虜の移送を秘密にすることに合意したという書面による証拠があると述べた。
articles.summaryOriginal: South Korea said Friday it has written proof that it and Kyiv agreed to keep the transfer of two North Korean POWs secret, as President Lee Jae Myung warned Ukraine to apologize or face additional measures. The dispute deepened after Volodymyr Zelenskyy disclosed the transfer in his U.N. General Assembly speech on Sept. 23. Seoul says diplomatic records support its position, while Ukraine denies any confidentiality deal existed. South Korea and Ukraine are discussing wording for a possible Ukrainian statement, including an apology. President Lee Jae Myung delivers a speech during a ceremony for the 30th Senior Citizens Day in Seoul, Friday. Yonhap

articles.titleJa: クーパンは、FTCの調査タスクフォースの最初のターゲットになることを恐れていました
articles.summaryJa: Coupangは、監視機関が複雑なプラットフォーム違反のための新しいタスクフォースを立ち上げたため、ソウルでより厳しいFTCの精査の見通しに直面しています。Coupangはすでに、割引コスト、検索ランキング、サプライヤー取引、食品配達事業をめぐる複数の規制紛争に取り組んでいる。
articles.summaryOriginal: Coupang is facing the prospect of tougher FTC scrutiny in Seoul as the watchdog has launched a new task force for complex platform violations. The bureau comes as Coupang is already fighting multiple regulatory disputes over discount costs, search rankings, supplier dealings and its food delivery business. The FTC has not named its first target, but officials and industry figures say Coupang could be among the earliest cases. Fair Trade Commission Chairman Ju Biung-ghi answers questions from reporters during a press conference at Government Complex Sejong, Sept. 21. Yonhap
